若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。
证据门槛按最终 factStatus 判断，不按来源数量机械升级：official 要求已打开一手来源；单一已打开、注册为 media 的可信媒体，只要主体、窗口和核心事实清楚，就可以 media_report 发布，不得仅因“只有一家媒体”或 readiness=single-media 而 needs_review；可信媒体明确转述可识别的官方公告、采访或发言时，可以 media_relay_official，verification 写清转述链。multi_source_verified 才要求两家独立可靠来源。readiness 只描述证据组成，不是发布资格。未确认但具有新闻价值且来源边界清楚的内容可进 rumors，factStatus=unconfirmed、tracking=true，并在标题摘要保留不确定性；只有主体身份未解、来源互相冲突、固定窗口无法确认、动态聚合数据缺少所需快照等实质阻塞才使用 needs_review。A级也不豁免时间/来源要求。中英文新闻标题和archiveTitle须自带明确的游戏、公司或人物主语，离开上方主体栏仍能独立理解。中文直述具体事实，verification 说明证据边界，不用宣传套话。
每个 include 决定必须填写完整 sharedFactFrame，作为两种语言共用的事实边界；subjectTitleKey/platforms 必须与最终 Canonical 决定一致，日期、时刻、数字、人物机构、版本专名只能来自所选证据，不得新增。

packages.headline: METRO Redux Next-Gen Update Out Now for XBOX Series X|S

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
The METRO Redux Next-Gen Update is out now on XBOX Series X|S, with an unprecedented degree of immersion, thanks to performance improvements, enhanced visuals, and control upgrades.
METRO Redux Next-Gen Update Out Now for XBOX Series X|S
The METRO Redux Next-Gen Update is out now on XBOX Series X|S consoles. Right now, you can experience both METRO 2033 & Last Light Redux with an unprecedented degree of immersion, thanks to performance improvements, enhanced visuals, and control upgrades that combine to take full advantage of the latest XBOX hardware.
First, the Next-Gen Update transforms the experience of playing both games through a series of major performance improvements. Once you’ve downloaded and applied the free update, you’ll be able to experience both titles in either true 4K resolution at 60fps or upscaled 4K at an even smoother 120fps. 4A TSR Upscaling and Antialiasing support will give players an even sharper, high fidelity experience.
Additionally, XBOX Ally and Ally X owners can look forward to full support and optimisation, plus the addition of XBOX Play Anywhere means fand and newcomers alike can truly experience the immersive world of METRO wherever they are.
Beyond these visual upgrades, the developers at 4A Games have also deepened the immersive quality of both titles by taking advantage of the latest XBOX controller hardware. With the Next-Gen Update, METRO players will experience full support for the XBOX controller’s Impulse Triggers, ratcheting up the tension through tactile feedback. METRO’s apocalyptic worlds don’t just look better than ever before, they feel better to explore too.
Although the update improves the core gameplay and visual experiences of both METRO 2033 and METRO Last Light , the 4A team has tuned each change carefully to authentically preserve the look and feel of the original games. The METRO universe has earned a passionate following over the last 16 years, and the new update’s been designed to respect the community’s deep affection for the worlds they already know.
If you’re a METRO veteran the Next-Gen Update gives you the chance to experience familiar worlds with fresh eyes, and a tenser, richer atmosphere throughout. Meanwhile, the update gives newcomers the perfect opportunity to lose themselves in a modern refresh of the series ahead of METRO 2039 ’s launch on February 4, 2027.
More than 50 million players have explored the grim, haunting worlds of the METRO series since the first game launched in 2010. Whether you’ve been with the series since the very beginning, or you’re feeling ready to take your first fearful steps through Moscow’s Metro, there’s never been a better time to lose yourself in 4A Game’s acclaimed atmospheric storytelling and experience the iconic, intense stealth-action gameplay of the METRO universe.
As significant as these improvements are by themselves, there’s more to the update’s visual overhaul than enhanced framerates and sharper detailing. Alongside these core performance upgrades, the update dramatically modernises both titles with the introduction of more detailed textures, a refined lighting and shadow system that impacts every corridor and corner of each world, richer environmental detail, and enhanced animation fidelity.

Once Human: From A Misplaced Lighthouse to the Living Ocean of Isles of Abyss
We recently released Isles of Abyss – the largest free expansion in Once Human history – on XBOX Series X|S. Now that players have had taken some time to chart these dangerous waters, we wanted to take this opportunity to pull back the curtain on how this major expansion came together and how we managed to take our signature “New Weird” and strange worlds survival into the open ocean by completely rethinking our world design. We didn’t want the sea to be an empty transit space connecting dry land. We wanted the ocean itself to actively hunt you.
Drawing inspiration from H.P. Lovecraft’s “The Shadow Over Innsmouth”, we wanted to subvert a familiar symbol of human safety. On land, a lighthouse guides travelers to harbor; in the distorted reality of Once Human , an anomalous light piercing the dark felt invasive and watchful.
We brought Once Human’s modular building system onto the water, giving you complete architectural freedom. How you engineer your vessel is your personal answer to the sea’s threats. Some players build stripped-down, lightning-fast skiffs designed to dodge whirlpools and outrun anomalies; others construct multi-deck floating fortresses lined with heavy naval cannons, crafting benches, and deep-sea diving rigs to blast through anything in their path.
To mark the launch, XBOX Game Pass Ultimate members can still claim the exclusive Once Human launch bundle through the Game Pass Perks gallery until November 18, 2026. If you haven’t yet weighed anchor on XBOX Series X|S or XBOX on PC, your crew is waiting.
Once Human — Ocean Expansion: Isles of Abyss Bundle
When our team began brainstorming this expansion, we didn’t start with endless waves, reefs, or nautical maps. It all started with a single, jarring image: a lighthouse standing where it had no right to be.
From that single wrong-feeling image, the ocean began to grow outward. That solitary lighthouse became an eye. An eye needed a body. And that body became the sea itself—a colossal, living organism known as The Sunken Lord .

packages.headline: Weave Your Own Fate: Titan Quest II Is Now Available for Pre-Order on XBOX Series X|S

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
Do you have what it takes to face a goddess? Titan Quest II launches on XBOX Series X|S on January 19, 2027. Pre-order now, combine two Masteries into a class that’s all yours, and start your journey 96 hours early!
Weave Your Own Fate: Titan Quest II Is Now Available for Pre-Order on XBOX Series X|S
High above the clouds, the gods of Olympus watch in silence – for once, even they are powerless against what is coming. The fate of the world now rests in mortal hands. Your hands. But do you have what it takes to face a goddess? The THQ Nordic and Grimlore Games teams are thrilled to announce that Titan Quest II launches on XBOX Series X|S on January 19, 2027. And starting today, you can pre-order the game on XBOX.
Titan Quest II is the successor to the beloved original Titan Quest : an action RPG set in a reimagined ancient Greece, where you set out to stop Nemesis, the Goddess of Retribution, from corrupting the Threads of Fate. Since the game entered Early Access on PC in August 2025, we’ve worked hand in hand with our community. We read the feedback, ran the numbers, and added new regions, new Masteries, new enemies and bosses, crafting, multiplayer, tons of loot, and much more along the way. With the full release, the story reaches its conclusion, and the complete journey comes to XBOX.
So, what makes Titan Quest II stand out in a genre full of great action RPGs? It starts with the heart of the series: the Mastery system. Instead of locking yourself into a fixed class at the start of your adventure, you pick two Masteries and combine them into a hybrid class of your own. Titan Quest II launches with six Masteries – Earth, Storm, Warfare, Rogue, Forge, and Spirit – and each of them can be freely paired with any other. That’s 15 distinct combinations before you’ve even looked at your gear.
Earth commands fire and stone for devastating area damage. Storm calls down lightning and frost to control the battlefield. Warfare is all about raw physical might, while Rogue strikes from the shadows with poison and piercing blades. Forge, inspired by Hephaistos himself, reinforces your weapons and armor in the middle of a fight and deploys blade traps, sentry turrets, and ferociously fighting automatons. And Spirit lets you summon the dead and draw on your hero’s life force to fuel otherworldly spells. Want to set up blade traps crackling with lightning? Pair Forge with Storm. Rather send the dead ahead while you strike from the shadows? Spirit and Rogue have you covered.
And the customization doesn’t stop at the pairing. Every skill can be shaped with modifiers that do far more than add a few percent of damage – some change how a skill behaves entirely, like turning a sweeping strike into a channeled whirlwind. Attribute points in Might, Agility, Vigor, and Knowledge let you fine-tune your hero even further, and if you ever want to rethink your build from scratch, you can respec at any time (the gods charge a little gold for it, of course).
Did we mention that every hero can use whatever weapons and equipment they prefer? You can wear full plate armor while wielding a frost magic staff, or charge into battle clad in leather while swinging a two-handed axe. And an archer dressed in fine linen works perfectly well with any Mastery. The choice is truly yours.
The second thing that sets Titan Quest II apart is how it plays. Combat is deliberate rather than frantic. Enemies fight in factions and combine their abilities, so reading the battlefield, dodging at the right moment, and smart positioning matter just as much as raw damage. Even your health potions encourage you to stay in the fight: they refill as you deal damage to your enemies. IGN Germany summed up the Early Access version as “the ARPG for everyone who finds Diablo too hectic” – and we’ll happily take that. With Rituals, you also decide for yourself how hard the gods should test you, adjusting the challenge freely to your liking.

『Bay 12: Mech Repair』は、巨大な戦闘用ロボット「メック」の整備士となるシミュレーションゲームだ。舞台となるのは、戦争が続く世界のとある格納庫。プレイヤーは一流のメック整備士として「Bay 12」と呼ばれる整備区画に配属され、戦場から帰還した巨大なメックを修理していく。故障した部品の交換はもちろん、溶接や穴あけといった作業を通じて機体を整備し、再び戦場へと送り出すのだ。

October 30 @ 7:30 am - 8:30 am EDT

sources.label: Game Informer
sources.evidenceText:
The multiplayer Switch 2 exclusive was originally scheduled to drop in 2026. - Game Informer
The Duskbloods Delayed To 2027 So FromSoftware Can Adjust 'Game Rules And Balancing'
While the 2025 reveal of the Switch 2 came with many surprises, none were as unexpected as The Duskbloods . It's a Switch 2 exclusive, multiplayer-only title from FromSoftware, the developer behind games like Dark Souls and  Elden Ring; in other words, not your typical Nintendo game. While The Duskbloods was originally scheduled to launch sometime this year, today the developer announced it's pushing the game's launch to 2027.
According to a post on The Duskbloods' X account , the main reason for the delay was balance-related. Here's the full statement:
While development of "The Duskbloods" is at the final adjustment stage, we have made the decision to move the launch window to 2027. We apologize to players who have been kindly awaiting the release of this title and thank you for your patience and support. During the network test, we saw active interest in the core concepts of the game, including combat, strategic depth, and player expression. To further enhance these aspects, we have decided to move the launch, allowing time for final adjustments to game rules and balancing.
We attended a hands-on preview session earlier this year and came away very positive, and sentiment was similar following the game's closed network test ( that is, when the servers were working properly ). It's not surprising that the devs have changes in mind following so much public feedback, though it is a little surprising that it will take until sometime next year for those adjustments to be complete.
To tide you over until the game's launch, check out our in-depth preview impressions or watch the video above to hear our live commentary over gameplay footage. You can also hear us discuss the game on our podcast, The Game Informer Show .

『ドカポンキングダム コネクト2』はRPG風“友情破壊”ボードゲームとして名高い『ドカポン』シリーズ完全新作。『ドカポンキングダム コネクト』の続編に当たる。
前作『ドカポンキングダム コネクト』は2007年にPS2向けに発売され、のちにWii版も発売された『ドカポンキングダム』のリメイク作品として、2023年にNintendo Switch/PC（Steam）向けに発売。オリジナル版は『ドカポン3・2・1 ～嵐を呼ぶ友情～』（1994年 スーパーファミコン）をベースに『ドカポン・ザ・ワールド』（2004年 PS2）の職業＆転職システムを採用。アイテムの増加とシステム全般の改良がなされている。リメイク版は後発のWii版の調整内容を反映しつつ、グラフィックを現行の環境にあわせて高解像度化。さらにマルチプレイがオンラインに対応し、世界中のプレイヤーと白熱の“友情破壊”合戦を楽しめるようになった。
そんな『ドカポンキングダム コネクト』をベースにした完全新作がこのたび発表された。ゲームシステムや基本ルールはこれまでの『ドカポン』シリーズを踏襲しつつ、全プレイヤーが一致団結して「ギガモンスター」に挑むPvE要素「大共闘戦」を新たに追加。勝利すると撃破報酬が“たんまり”ともらえるが、それを他のプレイヤーたちと分けあうか、あるいは独り占めするかという、友情が試される選択を迫られるようだ。
また、プレイヤーキャラクターには髪型、目、口などを細かく設定できるキャラクターメイキング機能を用意。一度作ったキャラクターは登録することで何度も使えるという。また、開発は『ドカポンキングダム』よりシリーズに長年携わるスティングが担当するとのことである。
『ドカポン』シリーズは近年、『ドカポンキングダム』をはじめ、過去に発売されたシリーズ作品の現行環境向けのリメイク、リマスターの展開を中心としていた。2020年にはアクアプラスの『うたわれるもの』シリーズとコラボレーションした『ドカポンUP！ 〜夢幻のルーレット〜』が発売されているが、純粋な『ドカポン』としてのコンソール機向け完全新作は『ドカポン・ザ・ワールド』以来、約23年ぶりとなる。
本作でプレイヤーはターンのはじめにルーレットを回して出た目の数のマス目を進む。行く先々で起こるモンスターとの戦闘を始めとするイベントをこなしてお金を稼ぎ、勝利を目指すのだ。1人のシングルプレイのほか、最大4人までのマルチプレイに対応している。

Some people are absolutely cracked with the Wingman. And now they’ll be able to use two at once. Cipher introduces Akimbo Wingman, which trades off some of the accuracy for big(ger) damage.
Apex Legends Update Lets You Dual Wield the Wingman, Brings Back Lifeline Revive Shield
Apex Legends: Cipher is coming on November 3 and it’s bringing a new weapon style that makes me scared. The Wingman is a semi-automatic revolver that utilizes Sniper Ammo, and it’s been the bane of my existence since Apex Legends launched.

The Wingman has wavered a bit in recent seasons and sits as the 19th most effective weapon in DPS terms, but it’s still deadly in accurate hands, across basically any distance. It’s two-to-four headshots for a Wingman kill depending on the armor they’re wearing, which is what makes it so deadly in the right hands.

packages.headline: Gears of War: E-Day Reportedly Sold Over 400K Copies Across Console and PC a Month After Day-One Game Pass Launch

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Sources tell The Verge that Gears of War: E-Day has sold over 400,000 copies across console and PC, and Game Pass is likely to blame.
Gears of War: E-Day Reportedly Sold Over 400K Copies Across Console and PC a Month After Day-One Game Pass Launch
The latest entry in the Gears franchise released to critical acclaim earlier this month, drawing high scores from reviewers and fans alike. (IGN scored the game a 9 out of 10 , saying its “stellar story campaign is complemented by an excellent multiplayer suite.”)
However, it seems the title’s popularity isn’t translating to sales — at least, that’s according to a new figure reported by The Verge . Correspondent Tom Warren cited a source who estimated that 400,000 copies of the game have been sold in total across consoles and PC, which paints a grim figure considering the prestige of this particular release.
Many are pointing to Xbox Game Pass as the reason for this surprisingly low figure. The game was a day-one release on the service, and was available for early access five days before its official launch via a $30 Premium Edition Upgrade, meaning that total units sold are most certainly lower than those who accessed the title through Game Pass. (It’s also worth noting that most players were under the impression this would be a multiplatform release until Xbox revealed it as a console exclusive just four months before launch.)
Data from Alinea Analytics appears to corroborate this thought. As laid out in an October 9 post from the research firm’s head of market analysis, Rhys Elliott, an estimated 1.7 million players accessed E-Day using their Game Pass subscription, rather than buying a copy.
As told by Elliott at the time of his post, “E-Day sold 62,000 copies on Xbox against 722,000 Premium upgrades, so for every one copy sold on Xbox, nearly 12 Game Pass upgrades were sold.” He surmised that Xbox accounted for nearly three-quarters of the game’s total revenue, but said that despite these seemingly low numbers, nearly 950K likely paid for the game in some way — just not by outright purchasing an actual copy.
These E-Day figures follow news that Xbox Game Pass might be receiving a major overhaul that could let subscribers pick which features they want to actually pay for. As told by Fortune , this would include "add-ons for console-only games, cloud gaming, and multiplayer, with the system operating on a tiered structure, according to people familiar with the strategy."
Analysts say more players likely accessed the title using Xbox's service than actually purchasing a copy.

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:

根強い人気を誇る銃撃RPG『エンド オブ エタニティ』“リマスター版のリマスター”PS5/Steamで配信開始。フレームレート120fps対応、倍速モード搭載の快適版
トライエースは10月30日、『 エンド オブ エタニティ ENHANCED REMASTER 』の配信を開始した。対応プラットフォームはPS5。PC（Steam）向けには『エンド オブ エタニティ 4K/HD EDITION』のDLC『END OF ETERNITY ENHANCED REMASTER』として配信開始されている。
『エンド オブ エタニティ ENHANCED REMASTER』は2018年発売の『エンド オブ エタニティ 4K/HD EDITION』をネイティブ4K出力・HDR・120fpsへと対応させた最新のリマスター版だ。
オリジナルの『エンド オブ エタニティ』は2010年、PS3/Xbox 360向けに発売。『スターオーシャン』『ヴァルキリープロファイル』などを代表作とするトライエースが開発し、セガが販売を担当した“銃撃多重奏”RPGである。プレイヤーは施設育ちの少年「ゼファー」、数々の依頼をこなして暮らす兄貴分の「ヴァシュロン」、ゼファーに助けられたことで一同に加わった少女「リーンベル」の3人を操作。荒廃した未来の地球を舞台に人類の生存維持装置で、巨大な機械仕掛けの塔「バーゼル」に隠された世界の真実と過酷な運命に立ち向かっていく。銃を使った攻撃をメインとし、戦略性と爽快感を両立させた独自のバトルシステムや、豊富なパーツを組み合わせて個性に富んだ銃を改造し、組み上げるカスタマイズシステムが特徴。また、世界観は過酷でシリアスでありながら、ギャグシーンが豊富でコメディ色の強いストーリーと、メインキャラクターの3人を筆頭とする個性の強いキャラクターたち、桜庭統氏と田中公平氏が手がける壮麗な楽曲も見所のひとつとなっている。
2018年には『エンド オブ エタニティ 4K/HD EDITION（RESONANCE OF FATE/END OF ETERNITY 4K/HD EDITION）』がPS4/PC（Steam）向けに発売。タイトルにも冠されている通りHD/4K解像度に対応し、テクスチャ全般が大きく進化したグラフィックが特徴。フレームレートも60fpsにして滑らかでスピーディな銃撃バトルが楽しめるようになっている。ほかにオリジナル版に存在したバグの修正、ロード時間の短縮といった改善も図られた。
今回の『エンド オブ エタニティ ENHANCED REMASTER』はそんなリマスター版をさらにリマスターした新バージョンとなる。具体的にはネイティブ4K出力・HDR・120fpsへの対応などグラフィックオプションを拡張。キャラクターや背景のテクスチャを再アップスケールし、より高精細で美しい世界を描き出している。また、「ゲーム速度2倍機能」の新たなオプションも搭載。よりハイテンポで快適なゲームプレイも実現している。ほかに対応言語も中国語（簡体字）、中国語（繁体字）、韓国語が追加され、全9言語になっている。
10月29日にはPC（Steam）版『エンド オブ エタニティ 4K/HD EDITION』のDLCとなる『END OF ETERNITY ENHANCED REMASTER』のストアページが突如公開（ 関連記事 ）。10月30日に配信開始とストアページ内に記載されていた。それに合わせるかたちで、2009年に作成されたTwitter（現X）のリーンベルのアカウントも8年ぶりに更新（ 関連記事 ）。PC（Steam）版のほかにPS4版にも何らかの動きがあることが示唆されたが、このたびPS5版が発表されると同時に電撃的に配信を開始。さらにPC（Steam）向けのDLCも配信されたかたちだ。

packages.headline: 『グランド・セフト・オートVI（GTA 6）』のマップは、『GTA 4』『GTA 5』『RDR 2』をぜんぶ合わせた広さに。しかもただ広いだけじゃない、ちゃんと“濃密”

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
『グランド・セフト・オートVI』のマップの広さは『GTA 4』『GTA 5』『レッド・デッド・リデンプション 2』の3作品のマップを合わせたサイズに匹敵するという。
『グランド・セフト・オートVI（GTA 6）』のマップは、『GTA 4』『GTA 5』『RDR 2』をぜんぶ合わせた広さに。しかもただ広いだけじゃない、ちゃんと“濃密”
ゲーム専門誌のEdgeは10月29日、『グランド・セフト・オートVI（GTA 6）』についてRockstar Games傘下のRockstar Northの開発責任者兼共同スタジオ責任者Rob Nelson氏への取材記事を GamesRadar+ にて公開した。それによると本作のマップの広さは『GTA 4』『GTA 5』『レッド・デッド・リデンプション 2』の3作品のマップを合わせたサイズに匹敵するという。
『GTA 6』は、Rockstar Gamesが手がける人気オープンワールドクライムアクションゲーム『グランド・セフト・オート』シリーズの最新作だ。PS5/XBOX Series X|S向けに11月19日に発売予定。本作の舞台となるのは、米国の架空の州であるレオナイダ州。過去作『グランド・セフト・オート：バイスシティ』などに登場した都市・バイスシティを擁する州だ。主人公となるのは、ジェイソンとルシア。シリーズ最大級に進化した規模と没入感が表現されるという。
今回のEdgeの取材ではNelson氏が90分ゲームをプレイしながらおこなわれた。それによると本作のマップの広さは『GTA 4』『GTA 5』『レッド・デッド・リデンプション 2』の3作品のマップを合わせたサイズに匹敵するそうだ。これまでもマップの広さは『GTA5』の2倍にあたり、『レッド・デッド・リデンプション2』の3倍の大きさにもなると伝えられていたが（ 関連記事 ）、より具体的に大きさが明らかになったかたちだ。
とはいえ昨今は『No Man’s Sky』のような、プロシージャル生成によって広大なマップを備えたゲームも珍しくない。求められているのは広さ以上にその密度だろう。Nelson氏と同じく開発責任者兼共同スタジオ責任者のAaron Garbut氏は『GTA 6』には『GTA 5』よりも桁違いの屋内エリアが含まれていると語った。また屋内については単なる空間ではなく、壁に写真が飾ってあったり、机の上にはさまざまなものが置いてあったりと住人がいることを確かに感じられるつくりとなっているそうだ。また、裏路地についても同様に緻密な作り込みがされているといい、開発者として長年本作に携わるGarbut氏でさえ、今でも見たことのない場所に出くわすことがあるという。
『 グランド・セフト・オートVI 』はPS5/XBOX Series X|S向けに11月19日に発売予定だ。
『グランド・セフト・オートVI（GTA 6）』のマップは、『GTA 4』『GTA 5』『RDR 2』をぜんぶ合わせた広さに。しかもただ広いだけじゃない、ちゃんと“濃密”

『GTA 6』は、Rockstar Gamesが手がける人気オープンワールドクライムアクションゲーム『グランド・セフト・オート』シリーズの最新作だ。PS5/XBOX Series X|S向けに11月19日に発売予定。本作の舞台となるのは、米国の架空の州であるレオナイダ州。過去作『グランド・セフト・オート：バイスシティ』などに登場した都市・バイスシティを擁する州だ。主人公となるのは、ジェイソンとルシア。シリーズ最大級に進化した規模と没入感が表現されるという。 
そんな「サウスパーク」の最新話となる「Guinea Pig On A Stick（串刺しのモルモット）」が10月29日に公開された。同エピソードではなんと約20秒にもおよぶ『GTA 6』のプレイ映像が公開されている。エンドクレジットにはRockstar Gamesへの謝辞も記載され、単なるパロディではなく、実際のゲームプレイ映像が使用されていることがうかがえる。
作中で『GTA 6』が登場するまでの経緯は次のとおりだ。舞台となるのは、11月に中間選挙を控えたアメリカ。そんななか、主人公のスタンやカートマンらの前に、とあるゲームの映像を「密輸」してきたと主張する女性が現れる。女性によると、同月に発売されるそのゲームがあまりに衝撃的すぎるため、アメリカの中間選挙に大混乱をもたらしかねないという。アメリカ存亡の危機だとして、そのゲームの危険性を訴えるという内容だ。そのゲームというのはもちろん『GTA 6』のことである。
Here’s the FULL GTA 6 gameplay footage exclusively shown in the latest South Park episode in HD. pic.twitter.com/aMBXWtnKE3
そうしてカイルたちの前で『GTA 6』の実際のプレイ動画が映し出される。映像では、飼い主の男性とともに浜辺を散歩するシェパード犬の姿が映し出されるが、便意を催した犬は浜辺に座り込んで脱糞してしまう。浜辺に落とされた黄土色のそれは、AAA級タイトルにふさわしい高精細なグラフィックで、実にリアルに描かれている。
公開された映像では、プレイヤーが地面に落ちている“犬の糞”を拾い上げ、NPCに向かって投げつける様子が確認できる。どうやら本作では、うんちを武器として使用できるようだ。高精細なグラフィックで描かれたうんちとともに、自由度の高いゲームプレイが紹介されている。

packages.headline: Assassin's Creed Valhalla Is Getting New Game+ 6 Years After Release

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Assassin's Creed Valhalla launched all the way back in November 2020, but Ubisoft just announced that it's getting its own New Game+ mode.
Assassin's Creed Valhalla Is Getting New Game+ 6 Years After Release
Assassin's Creed Valhalla launched all the way back in November 2020, but Ubisoft just announced that it's getting its own new game+ mode.
In a blog post, Ubisoft laid out some of its future plans for Assassin's Creed. One of them is a tiny, yet cryptic, update on Assassin's Creed: Codename Hexe . It also announced new game+ mode for Valhalla a mere six years after it first hit consoles.
The new game mode will be coming on November 5, and will include a new, optional progression mode, along with new runes, achievements and a stash system. Ubisoft will also be adding a new crafting material, Mithril, which can be used to upgrade divine gear.
But on top of the NG+ mode, Ubisoft teased that Valhalla will be getting even more updates. In the post, Ubisoft says it will "share full details in the upcoming Patch Notes, along with news regarding current-generation console updates in the coming days." It's not clear what Ubisoft means by "current-generation console updates," but I'd bet on a nice little graphics boost.
While Valhalla does have a PS5 and Xbox Series version, the game hasn't received a PS5 Pro Enhanced glow-up, so I'd guess that's what Ubisoft meant by console updates. But even outside of the Pro, in the years since Valhalla came out, every console has been updated with better upscaling, whether that's QSSR on the base PS5 or FSR 4.1 on the Xbox Series consoles.
Assassin's Creed was well received at launch. When IGN reviewed it, we gave it an 8, with reviewer Brandin Tyrrel saying, "Assassin's Creed Valhalla is a massive, beautiful open-world fueled by brutal living and the dirty work of conquerors. It's a lot buggier than it should be but also impressive on multiple levels."
The new game+ mode isn't the first time Ubisoft has slow-walked updates for Assassin's Creed Valhalla. Players also had to wait nearly two years to get Steam achievements , and the company was still fixing bugs with the game as late as January 2025.

packages.headline: Attack on Titan 3: The Final Preview

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Attack on Titan 3 may come with a number, but it isn’t a direct sequel in the truest sense of the word. It’s more of a retelling. Based on my time with it, Attack on Titan 3 is juggling a lot of plates, and its ambition to do something new with the franchise is pretty laudable.
Attack on Titan 3: The Final Preview
I must confess something before I get this preview started: I bowed out of Attack on Titan early. After the first season, actually. I didn’t think it was terrible or anything. I was there for the human drama. Little people swinging around like Spider-Man and dealing with their trauma while playing a game of David and Goliath against big, scary Titans. But when those little dudes started being able to become Titans, well… it just wasn’t for me. But after spending some time with Attack on Titan 3 and speaking to producer Hideo Suzuki, I’m tempted to give it another go… at least as a video game.
Attack on Titan 3 may come with a number, but it isn’t a direct sequel in the truest sense of the word. It’s more of a retelling. Part of that, Suzuki told me, was because it’s been seven years since Attack on Titan 2: Final Battle. “Right after the previous game, we already had started talking about the sequel, but at the time the anime series was still ongoing. So we were like, ‘What kind of concept should [the next one] be?’ And we did think about just covering the new parts of the anime series, but as a game or as a one product, we didn't think it was quite enough. So we were like, ‘Okay, one series is coming to an end, so why don't we just cover the story from beginning to the end and just kind of follow that storyline?’”
But Attack on Titan 3 isn’t just a straight retelling. You’ll be strapping on your ODM gear as an original character, but your backstory is interesting. After your squad is wiped out on your first mission as a squad leader, your character – I named mine John Titan, not knowing I could later choose their gender – is too traumatized (and afraid of fighting Titans) to continue. But since they also happen to be a great engineer and a generational talent with ODM gear, they’re kept on to fix things and train new recruits. It’s an interesting role to step into; games rarely ask you to embody deeply traumatized people who are so badly mentally broken that they have to step away from what they were great at.
Suzuki, however, told me that decision was intentional. “The reason that we had that kind of story in the beginning is we needed to establish that the Titans are the humans’ enemy. So the character goes to battle, he experiences the loss and trauma and then goes back with a stronger determination to fight Titans from then on. This time, the character is set up as a senior to Eren and other characters. And I mean, although he is a senior or more veteran trooper, if he's so strong from the beginning, there won't be much story to tell. So we have to have some kind of setback in the beginning for him to go through and it's that incident in the beginning. And then he's going to kind of play the role of Eren and others' mentor, but then they will work together and then they recover from the trauma and grow after.”
After playing with the character creator, I’m assigned to the 104th cadets, where I’ll be instructing Eren Jaeger, Armin Arlett, and Mikasa Ackerman, among others. My job, along with another hard-assed instructor named Keith, is to mold these kids into proper soldiers. But we have to break them first. You have to prepare the clay before you can shape it. packages.headline: Bethesda Pays Tribute to Patrick Stewart for His Role in Oblivion, Fans Remember His Role in Games like Castlevania

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Bethesda has paid tribute to Sir Patrick Stewart for his role in The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion after his death.
Bethesda Pays Tribute to Patrick Stewart for His Role in Oblivion, Fans Remember His Role in Games like Castlevania
Earlier today, it was announced that beloved actor Sir Patrick Stewart, best known for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men, died at 86 years old . The news came as a shock to many, and social media has been full of tributes to the actor. Many of his longtime collaborators, such as William Shatner, Kevin Feige, and Hugh Jackman all shared kind words about their time working with him.
Bethesda also offered up its own tribute by acknowledging the actor's death, calling him an "inspiration to us all." Stewart had a brief role in The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion as Emperor Uriel Septim VII, who is killed off at the very beginning of the game. Despite having minimal screen time, his character is the one who introduces you to the world of Cyrodiil and the looming threats that you will contend with.
Rest in peace to Sir Patrick Stewart — an emperor, a captain, and an inspiration to us all. Our thoughts are with his loved ones. https://t.co/dDzYWyDpV3
Despite having less than 10 minutes of screen time in the game, Bethesda put together a massive, overly-detailed document (reportedly as long as 90 pages) about the history and details of the Emperor. They thought that maybe they'd gone too far and worried that Stewart would ignore all of it, but executive producer Todd Howard stated that the actor was thrilled with the depth they had given the character and was excited to play him.
In a behind-the-scenes documentary about the making of Oblivion, developers gathered around in a room to listen to Stewart's first recordings for the game, gushing over how well he performed lines, some of which they feared would be cheesy. One developer was so enamored by Stewart's career that he carried around a picture of the actor in his wallet.
"The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion would not have hit the same without the iconic introduction and prologue led by Patrick Stewart as Emperor Uriel Septim VII," said one fan .
"An emperor, a captain, and an inspiration to us all."

packages.headline: Celeste and TowerFall Developer Explains Why Games Were Abruptly Delisted from Xbox

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Celeste and TowerFall have been delisted from Xbox, as the developer has chosen to boycott Microsoft for its involvement and investments with the Israeli government.
Celeste and TowerFall Developer Explains Why Games Were Abruptly Delisted from Xbox
Developer Maddy Thorson, the mind behind Celeste and TowerFall, confirmed on Bluesky that her team had removed the games from Xbox. They are no longer available to purchase on the platform, which caught some fans by surprise. Thorson stated that she made the decision to remove the titles in support of the Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS) movement, which describes itself as a “Palestinian-led movement for freedom, justice and equality.” IGN has asked Microsoft for comment on the situation.
The movement targets companies that are involved with or invested in the Israeli government amidst the ongoing conflict between Israel and Palestine. Celeste and TowerFall are not the first games to drop Xbox as a result of this movement, either. Earlier this fall, the beloved co-op adventure game, Big Walk, chose not to release on Xbox and cited the boycott as its reason . The team noted that, should Microsoft divest from its Israeli ties and be removed from the list of BDS targets, Big Walk would be brought to Xbox.
"We have made the decision not to release Big Walk on Xbox, in accordance with the Palestinian-led BDS (Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions) movement’s call to boycott Microsoft, and their designation of Microsoft Games (and Xbox) as a priority boycott target," said Big Walk developer House House at the time. "If you need help understanding our motives, we would recommend reading about why Microsoft is a BDS priority target, the successes this kind of pressure has already had on Microsoft, and especially, watching this great introductory piece by People Make Games ."
Celeste and TowerFall have both been out for some time, with the latter having been released in 2013 and the former in 2018. Both games remain available for purchase on PlayStation, PC, and Switch.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.
"We did this to support the BDS boycott."
